title: Chapter 272
text:
There were some who drew a single draw, and some who drew ten in a row. However, there was no difference. Han Xiao only controlled the overall cost of a batch of chests, and he did not care about the exact time when the chests were sold. It all depended on the players' luck. There was no such thing as under-the-table manipulation. He wanted the players to feel the warmth of home. The most low-traffic, advertising-free site on mobile phones.

If there was a guarantee for ten consecutive draws, more people could be attracted. However, he was using a limited purchase model. There were only so many chests in each batch, and they would definitely be sold out. Even if he did not earn more, it would increase the cost.

If there was a guarantee for ten consecutive draws under the premise of limited purchase, there might be rich guilds who would buy in bulk and use their resources to crush normal players. That would not be good.

In the first batch of chests, there was only one purple item, Jade Green Skies. Only this item was given out by Han Xiao himself to ensure that it would attract the interest of the players. He did not care about the other chests. Other than the discarded parts, there were a few blue equipment, a dozen green equipment, and some useful parts and materials.

The players could accept this drop rate. Some were happy, while others were sad.

In the first batch of over seven hundred chests, only a small portion of the thousands of players bought them. The others watched from the side.

"This batch of overstocked goods has been dealt with. I will clear the warehouse regularly in the future," Han Xiao said.

"Ah, that's it?"

The players wanted more. They were itching to buy more.

It was useless even if they wanted more. The players could only watch as Han Xiao drove away.

The players who had gained something were happy. Half A Cigarette When Lonely was envious. He touched his wallet and hesitated.

"Three thousand per chest. So expensive. I can't get anything good with my luck. Should I buy it?"

…

Three thousand per chest. I sold over seven hundred chests this time. That's probably … a lot of money. Han Xiao calculated in his mind as he drove.

After deducting the cost, there was a net profit of about a few hundred thousand. This allowed the capital to flow in and out continuously. It completely covered the cost of buying materials and building machinery. It was more stable and profitable than selling goods. He put high-quality equipment in the chests that matched the players' levels. He would not give out anything that was too good to be true.

The first unboxing event caused a lot of discussion among the players in the shelter, and their excitement was piqued. Han Xiao struck while the iron was hot, and after a few days, they started the next unboxing event.

After four consecutive times, the players finally began to get used to this regular activity. Every time it was a fixed time, the players would wait in the square in advance for Han Xiao's car to arrive, rubbing their hands in anticipation.

There were hundreds of boxes in each batch. In the beginning, it took twenty minutes to sell them all, but by the fourth time, they were all sold out in just six minutes. This showed that the players' acceptance and love for this event had increased.

Han Xiao's goal of organizing this event was a success.

The Blue Star section of the forums was spreading this news. Almost all the players had never seen a Purple equipment before, and they didn't know where to get one. At this critical moment, Han Xiao's Open Treasure Chest event had appeared out of nowhere, and it was the only way to get a Purple equipment. Naturally, it received a lot of attention, and its influence gradually spread.

Han Xiao saw that the forum was bustling with noise and excitement. A few players who had drawn purple equipment had posted to show off, and there were many envious and jealous replies.

"Greetings to the big boss in the purple suit."

"Sigh."

"Gambling doesn't change what's wrong, Xuan doesn't change fate, Europeans eat our African Giants!"

"Another round of ten! Don't pull me, I'm not crazy! I'll definitely get a Purple this time! My intuition won't be wrong! "

"I thought this game was different from those flirtatious b * tches outside, but I didn't expect you to betray the revolution too!"

"This day, the Africans finally remembered the fear of being dominated by bloodlines …"

"Content caused discomfort, reported!"

"BGM: We're different, different."

"Ten consecutive draws, no guarantee, single draw is a miracle, I've learned something new, Shoot Filth, Shoot Filth …"

"Guild of Gods buying Purple equipment, price negotiable, private message."

"Sky Territory buying Purple equipment, price higher than Guild of Gods, private message."

"Nine draws all black, silently watching the OP show off."

"Thirteen draws all black, passing by, laughing and touching the head of the dog above."

"Eighteen draws all black people are crazy, f * ck, I'm going to rob Black Phantom's warehouse tomorrow!"

"Highest respect to the brother above, you're a fighter for liberation, you're the flame of revolution, I'll take care of your wife and daughter, don't worry, have a good trip, salute!"

"Salute + 1! Keep the formation below. "

"Salute + 2!"

"Salute + 2, 3, 3."

All the players were complaining non-stop, and it was very lively, spontaneously giving Han Xiao a name for his lucky draw:!

Always leading the trend, never being surpassed.

…

With a large amount of money in his account, Han Xiao did not care about the price and bought materials and parts in bulk, spending most of his time in the workshop building machines, converting the Aquamarine Dollars into valuable materials and machines, and at the same time gaining a lot of manufacturing experience. He also created low-grade purple equipment as prizes, so he was way ahead of the players. The machines that he did not use were rare equipment to the players, and his development was not in vain. It was now the season of harvest.

The sanctuary was on the right track, and Huang Yu took care of the miscellaneous matters, so Han Xiao only needed to sign the documents.

Hella was accompanying Aurora in her rehabilitation training, Mad Blade, Maple Moon, Pork Bun, and Hao Tian received missions from Han Xiao to play with Aurora, and the Han Technician was basically in a semi-free mode for them for the time being.

At the same time, Han Xiao did not forget to take a look at the direction of the war occasionally. The Six Nations' situation was very good, and the Germinal Organization was basically in a state of collapse. He estimated that after a while, the Germinal Organization would happily announce GG, ending the war completely, and the whole of Blue Star would be liberated from the shadow of war.

The last time he browsed the information on the Dark Net, there were twenty to thirty percent fewer wanderers than before the war, and they had joined various forces to seek protection. This made Han Xiao feel strange, as if the war had promoted the establishment of order, and the 'free people' in the wild returned to the arms of the ruling class because of fear.

The situation was developing in a better direction, but Han Xiao believed in Murphy's Law. Before the dust settled, he did not want to pay too much attention to the war, in case there were any accidents. Anyway, he had done what he could. All the information was provided by him, and he had also harvested the combat power of the Germinal Organization's Executive Officers. He had the upper hand in terms of combat power and intelligence. If he still could not win, then the Six Nations could go to hell.

Han Technician temporarily focused on the players' main city plan. The players were an important part of the plan, and he valued them very much.

On this day, Han Xiao pulled another cart of boxes, and the players swarmed toward him.

In every event, the King of Single Draw, who was always talking, did not make a move. He was very patient, observing like a hunter, recording the results of the other players and calculating the drop rate. Influenced by him, the King of Single Draw was surrounded by a circle of players, and they followed suit.

At this time, a confident voice exploded in the crowd.

"Give me a hundred boxes!"

Everyone was shocked. They looked toward the source of the voice and saw a player with the ID 'So Poor All That Has Left Money' walk out.

"So Poor All That Has Left Money, is this a real tycoon?"

"A hundred boxes is equivalent to three hundred thousand aquamarine dollars. F * ck, that's a sky-high price!"

"So he's a real tycoon! Let's be friends! "

"That's a big deal. In the past, only the big guilds could do consecutive draws, and the highest number of consecutive draws was fifteen. A hundred consecutive draws is too crazy, I've never seen it before!"

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. Such an arrogant ID was like a big leek walking in front of him.
